name: Dormagen (Germany)
description: Banner of the city arms of Dormagen: yellow with a black lion in the upper part, a blue wavy bar across the middle and a black cross on white in the lower part.
history: Municipal flag of Dormagen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: black cross on white from the arms
